artifacts_shape_check.name: artifacts_shape_check
artifacts_shape_check.value: ("artifacts"."kind" = 'link' and "artifacts"."url" is not null) or ("artifacts"."kind" = 'file' and "artifacts"."file_name" is not null and "artifacts"."file_size" is not null and "artifacts"."content_type" is not null and "artifacts"."sha256" is not null)

people_agent_check.name: people_agent_check
people_agent_check.value: ("people"."kind" = 'agent') = ("people"."handle" is not null) and ("people"."kind" = 'agent') = ("people"."avatar_parts" is not null)

people_signed_in_check.name: people_signed_in_check
people_signed_in_check.value: "people"."kind" = 'agent' or ("people"."host_account_id" is not null and "people"."last_login_at" is not null)

plugin_grants_target_check.name: plugin_grants_target_check
plugin_grants_target_check.value: (("plugin_grants"."person_id" is not null)::int + ("plugin_grants"."project_id" is not null)::int + ("plugin_grants"."grantee_plugin_key" is not null)::int + ("plugin_grants"."team_id" is not null)::int + ("plugin_grants"."everyone")::int) = 1

sessions_ended_check.name: sessions_ended_check
sessions_ended_check.value: ("transcript"."sessions"."ended_at" is null) = ("transcript"."sessions"."ended" is null) and ("transcript"."sessions"."ended" is null or "transcript"."sessions"."ended" in ('stopped', 'restarted', 'reset', 'crashed', 'exited', 'taken_over'))
